title: From Uber Driver to Futures Algo: Code That Works Best When It's Broken
author: uWaveAI
selftext: Well, I’ve been working on my timing and it wasn’t until I finished these videos last week did I ever notice how close my timing was.  To keep my costs down I only show they best and worst trades of each day and they are uploaded around 4:45pm every weekday. This is the 2nd week of the videos so I have 10 online now and you will probably be able to see my progress of getting my timing right. Some videos I am way to early in my entries, while others I am spot on. I tried loosening somethings yesterday and the results were mixed so I can safely say there is a very small tunable knob that saves my ass, but at the same time allows a few trades a day per index. So without further ado, here is yesterday’s video and I invite you all to comment.
